summary: Defines RADIUS support for the Extensible Authentication Protocol. A network access server passes EAP packets to and from the RADIUS server, wrapped in RADIUS messages, so many authentication methods can be used without the access server understanding each. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A building guard can let a call center check IDs of many kinds without learning each ID type. This memo lets a network box pass any kind of login check along to a central server.
